files.Title: Editor.Scripts.ConvertToTrainARObject
files.Summary: ConvertToTrainARObjects is an Editor script that adds a right-click context menu to GameObjects in the hierarchy named "Convert to TrainAR Object". When the object is eligible (therefore has a transform, MeshFilter and MeshRenderer), this can be used to convert GameObjects to TrainAR Objects, where behaviours (e.g. TrainAR Object) are automatically added and the mesh is combined an simplyfied.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.EditorTrainARObjectToolbar
files.Summary: The EditorTrainARObjectToolbar is the toolbar in the sceneview when using the TrainAR authoring overlay. It allows setting TrainAR Object states like active/inactive, grabbable, interactable, or combinable without opening an inspector.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.MeshCombinerEditor
files.Summary: The MeshCombinerEditor is a utility class that helps to combine meshes.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.OpenAuthoringToolOnLoad
files.Summary: Sets up a new checkout after its assets and Visual Scripting have finished importing. Subsequent editor sessions retain the user's scene, layout and build target.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.PlayModeButtonOverride
files.Summary:
The PlayModeButtonOverride editor script implements utility for the unity editor play buttons that overrides its functionality with TrainAR specific functionality to either switch the build target if there is an unsupported one currently selected or allow building to a device by clicking the play button.

This is done for convenience of building and also to prevent the playmode execution, as this is currently not supported by the framework.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.StateRequestSimulatorEditor
files.Summary: Adds the GUI to the inspector to simulate stateRequests to test the statemachine in the editor. This is an Unity Editor Utility Class for the "StateRequestSimulator" class.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.TrainARConvertObjectToolbar
files.Summary: Displays and initializes the editor toolbar which contains a button that initializes the conversion process for a TrainAR Object of the currently selected object.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.TrainAREditorMenu
files.Summary: The TrainAREditorMenu adds a top menu with options called "TrainAR" for trainAR specific funtionallity like building, switching plattform, switching the mode (TrainAR/Unity Editor), and other options.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.TrainARObjectConversionWindow
files.Summary: Instance of the Editor Window with enables the user to specify options for the TrainAR Object and initializes the conversion process.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.TrainARObjectOffsetToolbar
files.Summary: The TrainARObjectOffsetToolbar is a toolbar in the Scene view when using the TrainAR authoring overlay. It is displayed instead of the TrainARObjectToolbar when two objects are selected in the editor. It displays the positional and rotational offsets between the two selected objects, so the user can use them, e.g. for the FuseObjects functionality of the object helper node.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.TrainARTrainings
files.Summary: Where the trainings live and which one is edited in the authoring tool. Every training has its own folder Assets/Trainings/<Name>/ with <Name>.unity, <Name>_Statemachine.asset and <Name>_Info.asset.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.TrainARTrainingsWindow
files.Summary: The TrainAR Trainings tab (docked next to the simulator): one list with a box per training (preview with the round expert, name, description). Every box can be opened in the authoring tool, edited, duplicated and deleted; new trainings are added at the bottom. All trainings are part of the build and shown on the home screen; previews are rendered by every build.

files.Title: Editor.Scripts.TrainingPreviews
files.Summary: Renders every training's start setup (its objects as placed in the scene, no table, transparent background, seen over the trainee's left shoulder) into <Name>_Preview.png and sets it as the training's preview. Runs before every build (TrainAR build and Unity's build window).

files.Title: Interaction.AudioController
files.Summary:
The AudioController is a behaviour automatically attached to a TrainAR Object on conversion. It triggers its sounds for selection, deselection, grabbing, releasing and correct/incorrect interactions/combinations specific to this object.

When attached, it holds default sounds. Those can be replaced in the Unity Editor Inspector.

files.Title: Interaction.CollisionController.Intersection
files.Summary: The struct that holds references of intersections.

files.Title: Interaction.CollisionController
files.Summary: Detects and handles collisions of TrainAR Objects. This is e.g. used for combining GameObjects and visualizing interseted states through outlining and shading.

files.Title: Interaction.CrosshairController
files.Summary: The CrosshairController activates/deactivates the crosshair which is positioned in the middle of the screen. This can e.g. happen when an object is grabbed or an overlay is active.

files.Title: Interaction.InteractionController
files.Summary: Handles the interactions, i.e. grabbing, releasing, interacting and combining of the TrainARObjects.

files.Title: Interaction.MaterialController
files.Summary: Handles material related functionality for TrainAR objects.

files.Title: Interaction.ObjectLerpingController
files.Summary: When TrainAR objects are grabbed, they lerp towards to correct position attached to the camera instead of appearing there. The ObjectLerpingController handles the lerping towards the camera when the object is grabbed.

files.Title: Interaction.Outline.Mode
files.Summary: Differentiates the type of the outlines used.

files.Title: Interaction.Outline
files.Summary: The Outline script is automatically attached to TrainAR objects on conversion and handles the outlining for e.g. selection, success or failure. It is called and handled by the MaterialController.

files.Title: Interaction.ResetLostObjectController
files.Summary: The ResetLostObjectController resets TrainAR objects back to the original spawn point when they are released too far away of the assembly. This is to prevent objects from falling through the infinityPlane or disapearing when release while the training assembly has tracking problems and "flaots" away.

files.Title: Interaction.RigidbodyController
files.Summary: The RigidbodyController is attached to TrainAR object on conversion. It handles the activation and deactivation of physics, as we do want TrainAR objects to elicit physics when released but not when stationary as this could e.g. cause users to "knock over" the assembly with grabbed objects.

files.Title: Interaction.TrainARObject.CustomUnityEvent
files.Summary: The CustomUnityEvent that is used for the OnCombination event. This Event also passes a string with its invocation indicating the other to be combined with TrainAR objects name.

files.Title: Interaction.TrainARObject
files.Summary: The main behaviour script for a TrainAR object. This is automatically added when converting GameObject to TrainAR objects After adding this script all following RequiredComponents are added. SelectionBase, MeshCollider, BoxCollider, RigidbodyController, MaterialController, AudioController, Rigidbody, Outline, CollisionController. The TrainAR events that are triggered on actions are also defined in this script.

files.Title: Others.ARSessionIsReady
files.Summary: Detects if the ARSession is loaded and deactivates the loading screen.

files.Title: Others.ApplicationRuntimeManager
files.Summary: The ApplicationRuntimeManager handles the TrainAR menu lifecycle. It start and quits Trainings and Application.

files.Title: Others.LeaveAndResetARScene
files.Summary: Adds basic functionality like leave and reset application and scenarios.

files.Title: Others.MeshCombiner
files.Summary: The MeshCombiner is a utility class used by ConvertToTrainARObject to combine and simplify meshes before converting them into TrainAR objects and computing their outlines and adding behaviours.

files.Title: Others.ObjectInsideCollider
files.Summary: Detects collisions of the object it is attached to with other objects to enable combination.

files.Title: Others.PrefabSpawningController
files.Summary: Handles the initial spawning and positioning as well as the repositioning of the training assembly.

files.Title: Others.ScenarioCompleted
files.Summary: Handles the completion overlay that is shown at the end of the training.

files.Title: Others.SelectionBase
files.Summary: Editor utility script that is attached on TrainAR object conversion. With this, authors always select this object when a child is selected in the Scene view.

files.Title: Others.StartARScene
files.Summary: Starts the ARScene after the tutorial is finished.

files.Title: Others.StateRequestSimulator
files.Summary: Developer Utility. The StateRequestSimulator allows to test the visual scripting stateflows in the editor by simulating requests to the statemachine manually. This is attached to the framework but not active by default. To use it, the PlayModeButtonOverride has to be deactivated/deleted so the playmode can be entered. The StateRequestSimulator is attached to the root object of the TrainAR framework and can then be used in the Hierarchy.

files.Title: Others.TrainingCatalog
files.Summary: All trainings in the build (Resources/TrainARTrainings.asset), kept up to date by the editor tools. The home screen lists them.

files.Title: Others.TrainingInfo
files.Summary: Describes one training (Assets/Trainings/<Name>/<Name>_Info.asset): shown on the home screen and the first onboarding page, and its expert picture is used for the insights and the end screen.

files.Title: Others.TrainingSelection
files.Summary: The training chosen on the home screen. When a training scene is started directly (e.g. in the editor), it is the training of that scene.

files.Title: Static.CustomAction
files.Summary:
Custom actions are actions triggered by events outside of Interacting or combining (e.g. UI quizes) and can send parameters that are then checked against the statemachine.

This class is also what authors can use to trigger actions beyond the scope of TrainAR and can be handled by the statemachine by using the Action Node and the "Custom Action" type.

CustomAction can either be triggered form the instantiated or static context.

files.Title: Static.InteractionType
files.Summary: The type of interaction that is used in a StateInformation struct through a state change request.

files.Title: Static.StateInformation
files.Summary: The StateInformation is a struct created for state change requests. It holds the information of the request to the statemachine.

files.Title: Static.StatemachineConnector
files.Summary:
The StatemachineConnector connects interaction inputs with the visual scripting flow and outputs with the instruction, error and insight controller through events. It therefore functions as a funnel between the Visual Statemachine and the rest of the logic.

Either the visual statemachien decides whether actions are correct or wrong (default) or the connection can also be commented out and the decisions on wrong/correct actions can be made manually in the RequestStateChange method by using C# programming.

files.Title: Tracking.FetchAspectRatioFromARCamera
files.Summary: Fetches the projectionmatrix from one camera and diretly applies it to another one.

files.Title: UI.CrosshairOnOff
files.Summary: Controls the dynamic transformations of the crosshair. It activates and deactivates the crosshair but also visualizes the distance to a grabbable TrainAR object by converging the crosshairs size until the object would be selected (e.g. if the user is too far away from an object to grab it).

files.Title: UI.DirectInfoController
files.Summary: The DirectInfoBoxController handles the displaying of direct info boxes that are used to display insishgts to the user. It is triggerd through invocation of an action in the StatemachineConnector and therefore has no public methods.

files.Title: UI.ErrorOverlayController
files.Summary: The error overlay controller handles the error overlay, triggers it on actions from the statemachine and sets its texts. It is triggerd through invocation of an action in the StatemachineConnector and therefore has no public methods.

files.Title: UI.HomeScreen
files.Summary: The home screen: lists every training of the build (preview, name, description, round expert) and starts the chosen one's onboarding. Below the trainings follows the optional TrainAR footer (links, creator, funding, contact).

files.Title: UI.InputFieldAdjust
files.Summary: Keeps the input question above a keyboard whose bounds are reported by Unity. Native mobile input remains available when the platform cannot report those bounds.

files.Title: UI.InteractButton
files.Summary: Handles interactions with the interact button.

files.Title: UI.InteractionButtonController
files.Summary:
Handles the behaviour of the interaction buttons, such as enabling and disabling when appropriate or highlighting the combine button in orange when a combination would be possible.

It also allows for grabbed objects to be rotatable.

files.Title: UI.KeepAtBottom
files.Summary: Keeps a button's lower edge a fixed distance above the bottom of the safe area, on every screen length. With the distance equal to the button row's side margin, the buttons sit symmetrically in the lower corners.

files.Title: UI.OnBoardingController
files.Summary: The OnBoardingController handles displaying the onboarding animations for scanning the environment and placing the training assembly by automaticaly detecting at which point and where sufficient feature points for a plane were detected.

files.Title: UI.OpenSidePanel
files.Summary: Handles opening or closing of the side panel (burger menu) wiht options for help, quitting and replacing the assembly.

files.Title: UI.Question
files.Summary: The abstract class for questions to share the same UI functions.

files.Title: UI.QuestionnaireController.Answer
files.Summary: Holder for information for one answer.

files.Title: UI.QuestionnaireController.QuestionUITypes
files.Summary: The type of the UI custom action/question.

files.Title: UI.QuestionnaireController
files.Summary: The QuestionaireController provides the functionality to control the input field questions, reqular question and question lists. The input field question opens the keyboard and recives any given string input from the user. The regular question opens a question with up to four possible pre-defined awnsers. The question list opens a list with n possible items and continues when all right items were selected.

files.Title: UI.RoundExpertPicture
files.Summary: Shows the expert's picture in its round frame (the parent is a white circle): the picture is cropped to a centred square and cut round with a smooth edge by the Round Picture shader, so transparent pictures sit on the white circle and opaque ones are cut round, whatever the trainer uses. The frame's hard stencil mask is switched off (its edge is jagged).

files.Title: UI.SaveArea
files.Summary: The SafeArea scripts moves UI components when they would otherwise be occluded by e.g. cutout cameras or speakers on some newer smartphone devices.

files.Title: UI.SoftShadow
files.Summary: A soft shadow behind a UI element (buttons, the insight bubble, the expert). The shadow is a sibling right before the element that follows its position, size and scale. On buttons, it is only shown while they can be used.

files.Title: UI.StreamVideo
files.Summary: StreamVideo is a wrapper for the Videoplayer class and handles playing of the onboarding animations.

files.Title: UI.TopPanelController
files.Summary: The TopPanelController handpes updates to the UI panel of the trainign scenario, showing the instructions and progress percentage of the training.

files.Title: UI.TrainingIntroPage
files.Summary: The first onboarding page: shows the chosen training's name, its expert presenting the description (as on the end screen) and the preview.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.Action.TrainARActionChoices
files.Summary: The type of interaction to check against.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.Action
files.Summary: Implements the "Interacting", "Combining" and "Custom" Action functionality of the TrainAR Framework, therefore it checks if the user triggered the "Interact", "Combine" Buttons or triggered a CustomAction through scripts and allows to check this against the stored state in the visual statemachine.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.ActionFork.TrainARActionChoices
files.Summary: The type of interaction to check against.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.ActionFork
files.Summary:
Implements the "Interacting", "Combining" and "Custom" Action functionality of the TrainAR Framework, therefore it checks if the user triggered the "Interact", "Combine" Buttons or triggered a CustomAction through scripts and allows to check this against the stored state in the visual statemachine.

This is the fork version of the action node. Therefore there are multiple correct answers and the stateflow enters a fork depending on which one is selected.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.ActionMulti.TrainARActionChoices
files.Summary: The type of interaction to check against.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.ActionMulti
files.Summary:
Implements the "Interacting", "Combining" and "Custom" Action functionality of the TrainAR Framework, therefore it checks if the user triggered the "Interact", "Combine" Buttons or triggered a CustomAction through scripts and allows to check this against the stored state in the visual statemachine.

This is the multi version of the action node. Therefore all specified actions in this node have to be completed before advancing.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.ActionUI.TrainARUIActionChoices
files.Summary: The type of UI questionnaire triggered and check against.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.ActionUI
files.Summary: Implements the UI questionnaire functionality of TrainAR, therefore it triggers and checks against UI questions like text input fields, questionnaires, and question lists.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.Conclusion
files.Summary: Triggers the Completion overlay that shows the training assessment of the scenario and ends the stateflow/training.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.Feedback
files.Summary: Implements the "Feedback" functionality of the TrainAR Framework, therefore it triggers the error overlay modality to show feedback (e.g. for an incorrect important action).

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.Insights
files.Summary: Implements the "Insights" functionality of the TrainAR Framework, therefore it triggers the expert input modality to show additional insights and tips and optionally plays audio clips.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.Instructions
files.Summary: Implements the "Instruction" functionality of the TrainAR Framework, therefore it updates the isntrutions and progress percentage of the Top panel.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.ObjectHelper.TrainARHelperChoices
files.Summary: The available helper utility to select on the "TrainAR: Object Helper" nodes menu.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.ObjectHelper
files.Summary: The Object helper provides utility methods to toggle visibility, grabbability, interactability, and combinability of TrainAR objects, to destroy them, to get GameObject references to TrainAR object in the stateflow and many other utility functions.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.OnboardingSetup
files.Summary: Adds an EventHook for the onboarding setup that is used to trigger the start of the visual scripting stateflow after the onboarding was completed.

files.Title: Visual_Scripting.VisualScriptingEventNames
files.Summary: Registering a string name for your custom event to hook it to an event. You can save this class in a separated file and add multiple events to it as public static strings.
